summary: This informational document lists service requirements for Layer 2 provider-provisioned VPNs. It gives terminology, general requirements, and detailed needs from both customer and provider views, covering point-to-point VPNs (VPWS) and multipoint VPNs (VPLS).

eli5.summary: Before building private lines for customers, you write down what customers and the phone company each need. This is that wish list, for both one-to-one and many-to-many connections.
